BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to No. 7 Barnwell Avenue, a stunning mid-terraced residence presented in superb condition throughout with the added benefit of an attic conversion.  This beautifully maintained home offers bright, spacious accommodation combined with stylish finishes, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, families, or investors alike. 
From the moment you step inside, the sense of light and space is evident, with well-proportioned rooms designed for modern living.  The property has been tastefully decorated and is truly in walk-in condition. 
The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a spacious living room filled with natural light, and a well-appointed kitchen/dining area with access to rear garden.  Upstairs hosts three generously sized bedrooms and a family bathroom. The attic is suitable for conversion to a 4th bedroom. 
The rear garden is a standout feature of this home. Enjoying a sunny orientation, it has been thoughtfully landscaped with artificial grass and raised flowerbeds, offering a perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or relaxing in a private environment.
Barnwell Avenue is ideally positioned within this highly sought-after development, just minutes from a host of local amenities including;
•	Hansfield Rail Station, Ongar Village 
•	Excellent bus links 
•	SuperValu Shopping Centre
•	Primary and secondary schools  
The area also benefits from easy access to Blanchardstown Shopping Centre, the M50, and Dublin City Centre. 
No. 7 Barnwell Avenue presents a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey home in a prime residential location with future potential. Combining style, space, and convenience, this property is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers.
